text_block_list.text:
The day has finally come for Mihono
Bourbon's
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Initiating scan. Heart rate and blood
pressure
normal. These results indicate
that I am relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Put simply, I am not nervous. However, I
can
become nervous if necessary. Are
those your
orders?

Her typical calmness brings me some
relief.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. I will execute your

command.
